tasks.title: Project Setup and Architecture Foundation
tasks.description: Set up the Xcode project with SwiftUI, MVVM architecture, Swift Package structure, and configure the base navigation shell (TabView with 5 tabs: Dashboard, Pantry, Shop, Insights, Profile using SF Symbols).
tasks.details:
1. Create Xcode project targeting iOS 17+ with SwiftUI lifecycle.
2. Set up MVVM folder structure: Models, ViewModels, Views, Services, Repositories.
3. Implement bottom TabView with 5 tabs using SF Symbols (22pt icons, SF Pro Text 10pt medium labels).
4. Configure the base 8pt grid spacing system and design tokens (colors, typography, spacing) as a DesignSystem struct.
5. Add the color palette constants: Primary Green #1F7A4C, Background #F8F9FA, Card #FFFFFF, Text #1C1C1E, Secondary #6E6E73, Error #D64545, Warning #F4A261, Success #2A9D8F, Divider #E5E5EA.
6. Add dark mode palette: Background #111111, Card #1C1C1E, Primary Text #FFFFFF, Secondary Text #A1A1A6.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify app launches under 2 seconds. Confirm all 5 tabs render. Validate color contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum). Test dark mode toggle.

subtasks.title: Create Xcode project with SwiftUI App lifecycle targeting iOS 17+
subtasks.description: Initialize a new Xcode project named FoodPan using SwiftUI App lifecycle. Set deployment target to iOS 17.0. Configure bundle identifier and project settings.

subtasks.title: Set up MVVM folder structure
subtasks.description: Create directory structure: Models/, ViewModels/, Views/ (with subfolders per screen: Dashboard, Pantry, Shopping, Insights, Profile), Services/, Repositories/, Extensions/, DesignSystem/. Add group references in Xcode project.

subtasks.title: Create DesignSystem with color palette (light + dark mode)
subtasks.description: Create DesignSystem/Colors.swift with Color extensions for all PRD colors. Light mode: primaryGreen #1F7A4C, background #F8F9FA, card #FFFFFF, primaryText #1C1C1E, secondaryText #6E6E73, error #D64545, warning #F4A261, success #2A9D8F, divider #E5E5EA. Dark mode: background #111111, card #1C1C1E, primaryText #FFFFFF, secondaryText #A1A1A6. Use Color asset catalog or adaptive colors. Primary Green unchanged in dark mode.

subtasks.title: Create typography and spacing token constants
subtasks.description: Create DesignSystem/Typography.swift with Font definitions: largeTitle 34pt bold, sectionTitle 20pt semibold, body 16pt regular, caption 12pt regular, button 16pt semibold. Line height multiplier 1.2. Create DesignSystem/Spacing.swift with 8pt grid: screenPadding 16pt, cardPadding 16pt, sectionSpacing 24pt, rowSpacing 12pt, cardRadius 16pt, buttonRadius 12pt. Minimum touch target 44pt.

subtasks.title: Implement TabView with 5 tabs using SF Symbols
subtasks.description: Create ContentView with TabView containing 5 tabs: Dashboard (house.fill), Pantry (refrigerator.fill), Shop (cart.fill), Insights (chart.bar.fill), Profile (person.fill). SF Symbol icons at 22pt. Tab label font SF Pro Text 10pt medium. Each tab links to a placeholder view. Apply design system colors to tab bar.

subtasks.title: Create placeholder views for all 5 tab screens
subtasks.description: Create DashboardView, PantryView, ShoppingListView, InsightsView, ProfileView as placeholder screens with centered title text. Apply background color from DesignSystem. These will be replaced by actual implementations in later tasks.

tasks.title: Database and Repository Layer Setup (Supabase)
tasks.description: Configure Supabase PostgreSQL backend with all tables defined in the PRD schema contracts (sections 19.1-19.4). Implement the repository abstraction layer with protocols.
tasks.details:
1. Add supabase-swift SDK via SPM.
2. Configure Supabase client with project URL and anon key.
3. Create PostgreSQL tables: users, households, pantry_items, shopping_items, transactions.
4. Set up Row Level Security (RLS) policies.
5. Create Swift data models matching schema.
6. Implement repository protocols returning Result<T, Error>.
7. Add composite indexes.
8. Enforce validation rules.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test each repository method. Verify CRUD operations. Test validation rules reject invalid data. Test real-time observation triggers on changes.

subtasks.title: Add supabase-swift SDK via Swift Package Manager
subtasks.description: Add the supabase-swift package (https://github.com/supabase/supabase-swift) to the Xcode project via SPM. Import Supabase module. Verify it compiles successfully with iOS 17 target.

subtasks.title: Configure Supabase client with project URL and anon key
subtasks.description: Create Services/SupabaseManager.swift as a singleton. Initialize SupabaseClient with project URL and anon key stored securely (not hardcoded — use a Config.plist or environment). Expose the client for use by repositories.

subtasks.title: Create PostgreSQL tables via SQL migrations
subtasks.description: Write SQL migration scripts for Supabase Dashboard: users (userId UUID PK, name text, email text unique, householdId UUID FK, role text check admin/member, createdAt timestamptz, updatedAt timestamptz), households (householdId UUID PK, name text, planType text, createdAt timestamptz), pantry_items (itemId UUID PK, householdId UUID FK, name text 1-120 chars, quantity double >=0, unit text check g/kg/ml/l/pcs, category text 1-40 chars, expiryDate timestamptz, costPerUnitMinor int >=0, lowStockThreshold double default 1, createdBy UUID FK, createdAt timestamptz, updatedAt timestamptz, archived bool default false), shopping_items (itemId UUID PK, householdId UUID FK, name text, quantity double >=0, unit text, completed bool default false, createdBy UUID FK, createdAt timestamptz, updatedAt timestamptz), transactions (transactionId UUID PK, householdId UUID FK, itemId UUID, quantityPurchased double, totalCostMinor int, costPerUnitMinor int, purchaseDate timestamptz, storeName text 0-80 chars).

subtasks.title: Set up Row Level Security (RLS) policies
subtasks.description: Enable RLS on all tables. Create policies: users can read/update own row. Household members can read all data within their householdId. Admins can insert/update/delete within household. Members can insert/update but not delete household or change roles. All queries scoped by householdId via auth.uid() join to users table.

subtasks.title: Create Swift data models with Codable conformance
subtasks.description: Create Models/User.swift, Household.swift, PantryItem.swift, ShoppingItem.swift, Transaction.swift. All conform to Codable and Identifiable. Use CodingKeys to map snake_case DB columns to camelCase Swift properties. Currency fields as Int (minor units). Dates as Date with ISO 8601 decoding.

subtasks.title: Implement PantryRepository protocol and Supabase implementation
subtasks.description: Create Repositories/PantryRepository.swift protocol with: fetchAll(householdId) -> Result<[PantryItem], Error>, add(item) -> Result<PantryItem, Error>, update(item) -> Result<PantryItem, Error>, delete(itemId) -> Result<Void, Error>, observeChanges(householdId) -> AsyncStream<[PantryItem]>. Create SupabasePantryRepository implementing the protocol using Supabase Realtime for observeChanges.

subtasks.title: Implement ShoppingRepository protocol and Supabase implementation
subtasks.description: Create Repositories/ShoppingRepository.swift protocol with same CRUD pattern as PantryRepository. Implement SupabaseShoppingRepository. Include real-time observation for shopping list sync across household members.

subtasks.title: Implement TransactionRepository protocol and Supabase implementation
subtasks.description: Create Repositories/TransactionRepository.swift protocol with: add(transaction) -> Result<Transaction, Error>, fetchByDateRange(householdId, start, end) -> Result<[Transaction], Error>. Implement SupabaseTransactionRepository.

subtasks.title: Add database composite indexes
subtasks.description: Create composite indexes in Supabase: (householdId, expiryDate) on pantry_items, (householdId, completed) on shopping_items, (householdId, purchaseDate) on transactions. These optimize the most common queries.

tasks.title: Authentication System
tasks.description: Implement authentication with Apple Sign In and email/password using Supabase Auth. Handle session persistence, role-based access, and the permission matrix (Admin vs Member).
tasks.details:
1. Configure Supabase Auth.
2. Implement Apple Sign In via Supabase Auth.
3. Implement email/password sign up and sign in.
4. Persist session across app launches.
5. Create AuthenticationService.
6. Implement permission matrix.
7. Enforce permissions client-side and via RLS.
tasks.testStrategy: Test sign-in flows for each provider. Test session persistence across app kill/relaunch. Test permission enforcement for Admin vs Member roles. Test sign-out clears session.

subtasks.title: Configure Supabase Auth in the project
subtasks.description: Enable authentication providers in Supabase Dashboard (Apple, email/password). Configure redirect URLs. Add Apple Sign In capability in Xcode project settings. Import AuthenticationServices framework.

subtasks.title: Create AuthenticationService with session management
subtasks.description: Create Services/AuthenticationService.swift as an ObservableObject. Properties: isAuthenticated (Published bool), currentUser (Published User?), currentSession. On init, check for existing Supabase session. Listen to auth state changes via supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange. Expose signOut() method that clears session.

subtasks.title: Implement Apple Sign In flow
subtasks.description: Create a SignInWithApple button using ASAuthorizationAppleIDProvider. On credential received, pass the identity token to supabase.auth.signInWithIdToken(provider: .apple). Handle success (navigate to app) and error states. Store user profile data in users table on first sign-in.

subtasks.title: Implement email/password sign up and sign in
subtasks.description: Create email/password sign-up via supabase.auth.signUp(email:password:). Create sign-in via supabase.auth.signIn(email:password:). Handle email confirmation if enabled. Show inline validation errors for invalid email format or weak password.

subtasks.title: Implement permission matrix as client-side service
subtasks.description: Create Services/PermissionService.swift. Define PermissionAction enum: addItem, editItem, deleteItem, manageMembers, deleteHousehold, changeRoles. Method canPerform(action:role:) -> Bool. Admin: all actions allowed. Member: addItem, editItem allowed; deleteItem, manageMembers, deleteHousehold, changeRoles denied. Use throughout UI to show/hide buttons.

subtasks.title: Implement root navigation based on auth state
subtasks.description: Update the App entry point to observe AuthenticationService. If authenticated and onboarded → show ContentView (TabView). If authenticated but not onboarded → show onboarding. If not authenticated → show WelcomeView/sign-in screen.

tasks.title: Onboarding Flow
tasks.description: Implement the onboarding user flow: App Launch → Welcome Screen → Create Account or Apple Sign In → Create Household → Add First Pantry Item Prompt → Dashboard.
tasks.details:
1. Create WelcomeView with app branding and sign-in options.
2. After authentication, prompt user to create or join a household.
3. Write household to database and link user.
4. Show 'Add Your First Item' prompt.
5. Track onboarding completion in UserDefaults.
6. Exit condition: navigate to Dashboard once at least one item exists.
7. Skip onboarding on subsequent launches.
tasks.testStrategy: Test full onboarding flow end-to-end. Verify exit condition works. Verify skipping on re-launch. Test household creation writes to database.

subtasks.title: Create WelcomeView with app branding
subtasks.description: Design WelcomeView with FoodPan logo/icon, tagline ('Reduce waste. Save money. Simplify meals.'), and two sign-in options: Sign in with Apple button (native ASAuthorizationAppleIDButton) and email/password option. Apply DesignSystem colors and typography. Background #F8F9FA, Primary Green accents.

subtasks.title: Create sign-up/sign-in screen for email/password
subtasks.description: Build a form view with email and password fields, sign-up and sign-in toggle, inline validation errors, and submit button. Connect to AuthenticationService methods. Show loading state during API call.

subtasks.title: Create household creation/join screen
subtasks.description: After successful auth, show CreateHouseholdView. Text field for household name (required). 'Create Household' button writes to Supabase households table and sets user's householdId and role='admin'. Alternative: 'Join Existing' option (enter invite code or household ID).

subtasks.title: Build 'Add Your First Item' prompt view
subtasks.description: Create AddFirstItemView encouraging user to add their first pantry or shopping item. Show a simplified add form or 'Add to Pantry' / 'Add to Shopping List' buttons. This step is the exit condition trigger.

subtasks.title: Implement onboarding state management and routing
subtasks.description: Create OnboardingViewModel tracking current step. Persist hasCompletedOnboarding in UserDefaults. On app launch: if not authenticated → WelcomeView. If authenticated + no household → CreateHousehold. If authenticated + household + no items → AddFirstItem. Otherwise → Dashboard. Exit onboarding once at least one pantry or shopping item exists.

tasks.title: Household and Family Management
tasks.description: Implement household creation, member invitation, role assignment (Admin/Member), and member removal. Admin can promote/demote members.
tasks.details:
1. Create Household model with householdId, name, planType, createdAt.
2. Implement household creation (creator becomes Admin).
3. Implement add member flow (invite by email or link).
4. Role management: Admin can promote/demote.
5. Admin can remove members.
6. Max 20 members per household.
7. Display family members list in Profile.
tasks.testStrategy: Test household CRUD. Test role transitions. Verify max member limit enforced. Test permission checks for non-admin actions.

subtasks.title: Create HouseholdService for CRUD operations
subtasks.description: Create Services/HouseholdService.swift. Methods: createHousehold(name:) — creates household in Supabase, sets current user as admin. fetchHousehold(id:) — returns household details. updateHousehold(id:name:). deleteHousehold(id:) — admin only.

subtasks.title: Implement member invitation flow
subtasks.description: Create invite member functionality: admin enters email → system creates invitation record or sends email. When invitee signs up/signs in, they join the household. Validate max 20 members before allowing invite. Show error if limit reached.

subtasks.title: Build role management (promote/demote)
subtasks.description: Admin can change a member's role between 'admin' and 'member'. Create UI with role badge on each member row. Tap to toggle role (admin only). Update user's role in Supabase users table. Enforce via RLS that only admins can update role field.

subtasks.title: Implement member removal
subtasks.description: Admin can remove a member from the household. Show confirmation alert before removal. Update the removed user's householdId to null in Supabase. Members cannot remove others. Prevent admin from removing themselves if they are the sole admin.

subtasks.title: Build FamilyMembersView list UI
subtasks.description: Create Views/Profile/FamilyMembersView.swift showing all members in the household. Each row: name, email, role badge (Admin green, Member gray). Admin sees action buttons (promote/demote, remove). Member sees read-only list. Add Member button at top (admin only).

tasks.title: Pantry Item Data Model and State Machine
tasks.description: Implement the PantryItem model with computed state transitions: Active → LowStock → ExpiringSoon → Expired → Archived. State priority: Expired > ExpiringSoon > LowStock > Active.
tasks.details:
1. Create PantryItem struct with all fields.
2. Implement computed state property with priority ordering.
3. Create Unit enum.
4. Add validation rules.
5. Currency in minor units (Int).
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test every state transition. Test priority ordering. Test edge cases (quantity exactly at threshold, expiry exactly 3 days out). Test validation boundaries.

subtasks.title: Create PantryItem struct with all PRD fields
subtasks.description: Create Models/PantryItem.swift: itemId (UUID), householdId (UUID), name (String 1-120), quantity (Double >=0), unit (UnitType enum), category (String 1-40), expiryDate (Date?), costPerUnitMinor (Int? >=0), lowStockThreshold (Double, default 1), createdBy (UUID), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date), archived (Bool, default false). Conform to Codable, Identifiable, Equatable. Use CodingKeys for snake_case mapping.

subtasks.title: Create UnitType enum
subtasks.description: Create Models/UnitType.swift enum: g, kg, ml, l, pcs. Conform to String, Codable, CaseIterable. Add displayName computed property for UI labels (e.g., 'grams', 'kilograms', 'pieces').

subtasks.title: Implement ItemState enum with computed state property
subtasks.description: Create Models/ItemState.swift enum: active, lowStock, expiringSoon, expired, archived. Add computed property to PantryItem: var state: ItemState. Logic: if archived || quantity <= 0 → .archived. If expiryDate exists && expiryDate < Date.now → .expired. If expiryDate exists && expiryDate < Date.now + 3 days → .expiringSoon. If quantity <= lowStockThreshold → .lowStock. Else → .active. Priority ordering: expired > expiringSoon > lowStock > active.

subtasks.title: Add validation rules
subtasks.description: Create a validate() method or static validation functions on PantryItem. Rules: name 1-120 characters. quantity 0-1,000,000. expiryDate max 5 years from now. category 1-40 characters. costPerUnitMinor >= 0. Return validation errors as array of strings for inline display.

subtasks.title: Write unit tests for state transitions and validation
subtasks.description: Create PantryItemTests.swift. Test: active state when all normal. lowStock when qty <= threshold. expiringSoon when expiry within 3 days. expired when past expiry. archived when qty <= 0. Priority: item that is both lowStock and expiringSoon should be expiringSoon. Validation: test boundary values for all fields.

tasks.title: Pantry Screen UI
tasks.description: Build the Pantry screen with segmented control (All/Expiring/Low Stock/Categories), search bar, item list with swipe actions, and floating add button.
tasks.details:
1. Segmented control: All, Expiring, Low Stock, Categories.
2. Search bar pinned at top.
3. Each row 72pt: name, quantity, expiry, category tag.
4. Swipe left: Delete, Swipe right: Edit.
5. Floating add button 56pt circle Primary Green.
6. Card shadow radius 4, opacity 0.08, Y offset 2.
7. Haptic light impact on add.
8. Min 44pt touch targets.
tasks.testStrategy: Test segmented control filters correctly. Test search filters results. Test swipe actions trigger correct operations. Test floating button opens add modal. Test VoiceOver accessibility.

subtasks.title: Create PantryViewModel with filter and search logic
subtasks.description: Create ViewModels/PantryViewModel.swift as ObservableObject. Properties: items ([PantryItem]), selectedFilter (enum: all, expiring, lowStock, categories), searchText (String). Computed filteredItems based on selectedFilter and searchText. Fetch items from PantryRepository on init. Observe real-time changes.

subtasks.title: Build PantryView with segmented control
subtasks.description: Create Views/Pantry/PantryView.swift. Top: Picker with segmented style for filter options (All, Expiring, Low Stock, Categories). Below: searchable List of pantry items. Apply DesignSystem background color. Section spacing 24pt.

subtasks.title: Build PantryItemRow component
subtasks.description: Create Views/Pantry/PantryItemRow.swift. Height 72pt. Layout: item name (16pt semibold), quantity + unit, expiry date (with color coding: red if expired/expiring, amber if low stock), category tag pill. 1pt divider between rows. Apply design system typography and colors.

subtasks.title: Add swipe actions (Delete left, Edit right)
subtasks.description: Add .swipeActions to each row. Leading swipe (right gesture): Edit button (blue) → triggers edit modal. Trailing swipe (left gesture): Delete button (red) → confirmation alert → calls viewModel.deleteItem(). Both with 44pt minimum touch targets.

subtasks.title: Create floating action button (FAB)
subtasks.description: Create Views/Components/FloatingAddButton.swift. 56pt circle, Primary Green (#1F7A4C) background, white plus icon (SF Symbol 'plus'). Positioned bottom-right with padding. Shadow: radius 4, opacity 0.08, Y offset 2. On tap: light haptic impact → present add item modal sheet.

subtasks.title: Implement Categories grouping view
subtasks.description: When 'Categories' filter is selected, group items by category and display as sections with category headers. Each section shows item count. Tapping a category section expands to show items within it.

tasks.title: Add/Edit Pantry Item Modal
tasks.description: Implement the Add Item modal with fields: Item Name, Quantity, Unit, Expiry Date (DatePicker), Category dropdown, and Scan Barcode option. Also handle edit mode for existing items.
tasks.details:
1. Modal sheet with form fields.
2. Validation with inline errors.
3. DatePicker, category picker, unit picker.
4. Edit mode pre-populates.
5. Barcode scan placeholder.
6. Save to repository.
7. Haptic on errors.
tasks.testStrategy: Test required field validation. Test boundary values. Test save writes to repository. Test edit pre-populates correctly. Test offline save with sync badge.

subtasks.title: Create AddEditPantryItemViewModel
subtasks.description: Create ViewModels/AddEditPantryItemViewModel.swift. Properties: name, quantity, selectedUnit, expiryDate, category, isEditing, existingItem. Methods: validate() -> [String], save() async. In edit mode, init with existing PantryItem values. On save, call PantryRepository.add() or .update().

subtasks.title: Build AddEditPantryItemView modal sheet
subtasks.description: Create Views/Pantry/AddEditPantryItemView.swift as a sheet. Form layout: TextField for name, TextField for quantity (numeric keyboard), Picker for unit (UnitType cases), DatePicker for expiry (optional toggle), Picker/menu for category. Save and Cancel buttons in toolbar. Title: 'Add Item' or 'Edit Item'.

subtasks.title: Implement inline form validation
subtasks.description: Show inline error text (red, caption size) below each invalid field. Validations: name required (1-120 chars), quantity required (>0, max 1M), category required (1-40 chars), expiryDate max 5 years ahead. Disable Save button when validation fails. Haptic error vibration on submit with errors.

subtasks.title: Implement category picker with predefined options
subtasks.description: Create a category selection component. Predefined categories: Fruits, Vegetables, Dairy, Meat, Seafood, Grains, Snacks, Beverages, Frozen, Condiments, Other. Allow custom category text input. Remember recently used categories for quick selection.

subtasks.title: Add barcode scan button placeholder
subtasks.description: Add a 'Scan Barcode' button in the form that shows a placeholder/coming soon alert. Prepare the UI hook so barcode scanning can be implemented in a future update. Use SF Symbol 'barcode.viewfinder'.

subtasks.title: Connect save/update to PantryRepository
subtasks.description: On valid save: call PantryRepository.add(item) for new items or .update(item) for edits. Handle loading state (disable button, show spinner). Handle success (dismiss modal, light haptic). Handle error (show error message, keep modal open).

tasks.title: Shopping List Screen UI
tasks.description: Build the Shopping List screen (Reminders-style layout) with checkbox items, completed section at bottom, and bulk actions (Mark All Complete, Transfer to Pantry).
tasks.details:
1. Reminders-style list layout.
2. Checkbox items.
3. Completed items auto-move to bottom.
4. Bulk actions.
5. Inline add.
6. Swipe delete.
7. Max 1,000 items.
8. Real-time Supabase sync.
tasks.testStrategy: Test checkbox toggles. Test completed items move to bottom. Test bulk actions. Test add/delete. Test real-time sync.

subtasks.title: Create ShoppingListViewModel
subtasks.description: Create ViewModels/ShoppingListViewModel.swift. Properties: pendingItems, completedItems (computed from items where completed == true/false). Methods: addItem(name, quantity), toggleComplete(item), deleteItem(item), markAllComplete(), transferToPatry(). Observe real-time changes from ShoppingRepository.

subtasks.title: Build ShoppingListView with two sections
subtasks.description: Create Views/Shopping/ShoppingListView.swift. Two sections in a List: 'To Buy' (pending items) and 'Completed' (completed items, collapsible). Completed section at bottom. Apply DesignSystem styling. Section headers with item counts.

subtasks.title: Build ShoppingItemRow with checkbox
subtasks.description: Create Views/Shopping/ShoppingItemRow.swift. Leading: circular checkbox (tap to toggle). Center: item name (strikethrough + gray when completed), quantity. Swipe trailing: delete (red). Min 44pt touch target on checkbox.

subtasks.title: Implement inline item creation
subtasks.description: Add a text field at the bottom of the 'To Buy' section (or a floating row) for quick item entry. User types name, optionally quantity, and taps return/add to create item. Auto-focus on tap. Clear after add.

subtasks.title: Implement bulk actions toolbar
subtasks.description: Add toolbar or buttons: 'Mark All Complete' (marks all pending as completed), 'Transfer to Pantry' (opens transfer modal for completed items — triggers Task 10). Show item counts on buttons. Disable when no applicable items.

subtasks.title: Set up Supabase Realtime for shopping list sync
subtasks.description: Configure Supabase Realtime subscription on shopping_items table filtered by householdId. On insert/update/delete events, update ShoppingListViewModel's items array. This enables real-time sync across household members editing the same list.

tasks.title: Shopping to Pantry Transfer Flow
tasks.description: Implement the transfer flow: select completed shopping items → confirmation modal with editable quantities and auto-populated expiry → create PantryItem entries → create Transaction entries → remove shopping items → success toast.
tasks.details:
1. Transfer confirmation modal.
2. Editable quantity, expiry, cost per item.
3. Create PantryItem + Transaction entries.
4. Bankers rounding for cost per unit.
5. Success toast 2 seconds.
6. Haptic medium impact.
7. ShoppingItem states: Pending → Completed → Transferred → Archived.
tasks.testStrategy: Test full transfer flow. Verify PantryItems created. Verify Transactions recorded. Verify shopping items removed. Test cost rounding. Test toast.

subtasks.title: Create TransferViewModel
subtasks.description: Create ViewModels/TransferViewModel.swift. Input: array of completed ShoppingItems. For each item, expose editable fields: quantity, expiryDate (optional), totalCost (optional), storeName (optional). Method: executeTransfer() async that creates PantryItems and Transactions.

subtasks.title: Build TransferConfirmationView modal
subtasks.description: Create Views/Shopping/TransferConfirmationView.swift as a sheet. ScrollView with each item as a card: item name (read-only), editable quantity field, optional DatePicker for expiry, optional currency TextField for cost, optional storeName field. Bottom: 'Transfer to Pantry' button and Cancel.

subtasks.title: Implement bankers rounding for cost per unit
subtasks.description: Create Extensions/BankersRounding.swift. Implement: func bankersRound(_ value: Double) -> Int that rounds to nearest integer using .toNearestOrEven rounding rule. Used for: costPerUnitMinor = totalCostMinor / quantityPurchased. Write unit tests for edge cases (0.5, 1.5, 2.5, etc.).

subtasks.title: Implement transfer execution logic
subtasks.description: In TransferViewModel.executeTransfer(): For each item — 1) Create PantryItem with name, quantity, unit, category (if known), expiryDate, costPerUnitMinor (via bankers rounding). 2) Create Transaction with transactionId, itemId, quantityPurchased, totalCostMinor, costPerUnitMinor, purchaseDate (now), storeName. 3) Delete or archive shopping item (set status to transferred). All in a Supabase transaction if possible.

subtasks.title: Implement success toast and haptic feedback
subtasks.description: On successful transfer: show a toast/banner 'Items transferred to pantry' for 2 seconds. Medium haptic impact. Dismiss the transfer modal. Navigate back to shopping list which now shows items removed from completed section.

tasks.title: Dashboard Screen
tasks.description: Build the Dashboard with greeting header, expiry alert card, pantry snapshot card, shopping progress card, and financial snapshot card.
tasks.details:
1. Greeting Header with dynamic time-based greeting.
2. Expiry Alert Card.
3. Pantry Snapshot Card.
4. Shopping Progress Card.
5. Financial Snapshot.
6. Card shadow styling.
7. 24pt section spacing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dynamic greeting. Test expiry alert accuracy. Test snapshot counts. Test shopping progress. Test card navigation.

subtasks.title: Create DashboardViewModel
subtasks.description: Create ViewModels/DashboardViewModel.swift. Aggregates data from PantryRepository, ShoppingRepository, TransactionRepository. Computed properties: greeting (based on hour), expiringItems (within 3 days), totalPantryItems, categoriesCount, lowStockCount, shoppingTotal, shoppingCompleted, completionPercentage, monthlySpend, estimatedSavings.

subtasks.title: Build DashboardView with ScrollView layout
subtasks.description: Create Views/Dashboard/DashboardView.swift. ScrollView with VStack, 24pt spacing between cards. Background from DesignSystem. Pull to refresh support.

subtasks.title: Build GreetingHeader component
subtasks.description: Create Views/Dashboard/GreetingHeader.swift. HStack: VStack with 'Good Morning/Afternoon/Evening' (section title) + user name (body). Trailing: profile avatar 40x40pt circle (user initials or image). Tap avatar navigates to Profile tab.

subtasks.title: Build ExpiryAlertCard
subtasks.description: Create Views/Dashboard/ExpiryAlertCard.swift. Card with white background, 16pt corner radius, 16pt padding, shadow (radius 4, opacity 0.08, Y 2). Shows: 'Expiring Soon' title, count badge in red, list of up to 3 item names. Tap navigates to Pantry with Expiring filter selected.

subtasks.title: Build PantrySnapshotCard
subtasks.description: Card showing: total items count, number of categories, low stock indicator (count of items at/below threshold). Same card styling as ExpiryAlertCard. Tap navigates to Pantry tab.

subtasks.title: Build ShoppingProgressCard
subtasks.description: Card showing: total shopping items, ProgressView bar with completion percentage, 'Continue Shopping' button. Button navigates to Shopping tab. Percentage = completedItems / totalItems * 100.

subtasks.title: Build FinancialSnapshotCard
subtasks.description: Card showing: monthly spend formatted as currency, savings from avoided duplicates, trend indicator arrow (up green / down red). Tap navigates to Insights tab. Currency localized using Locale.current.

tasks.title: Financial Calculation Engine
tasks.description: Implement all financial calculations: Monthly Spend, Cost Per Unit, Waste Value, Duplicate Purchase Savings, Low Stock Optimization Savings.
tasks.details:
1. Monthly Spend: SUM transactions for current month.
2. Cost Per Unit with bankers rounding.
3. Waste Value on expiry.
4. Duplicate Purchase Savings.
5. Low Stock Optimization.
6. All currency in minor units.
7. Localized display.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test each calculation. Test bankers rounding. Test monthly boundaries. Test duplicate detection. Test zero and large values.

subtasks.title: Create FinancialService
subtasks.description: Create Services/FinancialService.swift. Depends on TransactionRepository and PantryRepository. Expose methods for each calculation. All monetary values in Int (minor units). Convert to display format only at the view layer.

subtasks.title: Implement monthly spend calculation
subtasks.description: Method: monthlySpend(householdId:month:year:) -> Int. Fetches transactions within the month date range. Returns SUM(totalCostMinor). Handle empty state (return 0).

subtasks.title: Implement waste value calculation
subtasks.description: Method: monthlyWaste(householdId:month:year:) -> Int. When a pantry item expires (state == .expired), calculate wasteValue = remainingQuantity * costPerUnitMinor. Track waste events. Return SUM for the month.

subtasks.title: Implement duplicate purchase savings detection
subtasks.description: Method: duplicateSavings(householdId:month:year:) -> Int. When user adds a shopping item that already exists in pantry above threshold, flag as potential duplicate. estimatedSavings = duplicateQuantity * costPerUnitMinor. Track as avoidedExpense.

subtasks.title: Implement low stock optimization savings
subtasks.description: Method: optimizationSavings(householdId:month:year:) -> Int. If item is marked low stock and user buys only the needed amount: optimizationSavings = (averagePurchaseQty - optimizedQty) * costPerUnitMinor.

subtasks.title: Add currency formatting utilities
subtasks.description: Create Extensions/CurrencyFormatter.swift. Convert minor units (Int) to localized currency string using NumberFormatter with Locale.current. Example: 1550 → '$15.50' or '£15.50'. Support all common locales.

tasks.title: Insights Screen with Charts
tasks.description: Build the Insights screen with Monthly Spend Chart, Waste Reduction Estimate, Most Purchased Items, and Category Spending Breakdown using native Swift Charts.
tasks.details:
1. Swift Charts framework.
2. Bar charts, flat colors, no gradients.
3. Chart padding 16pt, X axis 12pt, Y min 0.
4. Localized currency.
5. Empty states.
tasks.testStrategy: Test charts render with sample data. Test empty state. Test data mapping. Test currency display. Test accessibility labels.

subtasks.title: Create InsightsViewModel
subtasks.description: Create ViewModels/InsightsViewModel.swift. Fetches data from FinancialService and TransactionRepository. Properties: monthlySpendData ([MonthlySpend]), wasteEstimate (Int), mostPurchasedItems ([ItemFrequency]), categoryBreakdown ([CategorySpend]). Refresh on appear.

subtasks.title: Build InsightsView with ScrollView sections
subtasks.description: Create Views/Insights/InsightsView.swift. ScrollView with VStack: Monthly Spend chart, Waste Reduction card, Most Purchased list, Category Breakdown chart. 24pt section spacing. DesignSystem styling.

subtasks.title: Build Monthly Spend bar chart
subtasks.description: Using Swift Charts: BarMark for each month. Flat Primary Green bars (no gradients). Line thickness 2pt if using LineMark overlay. Chart padding 16pt. X axis labels 12pt (month names). Y axis minimum 0. Currency labels on Y axis.

subtasks.title: Build Waste Reduction section
subtasks.description: Card showing: 'Estimated Waste This Month' with currency value. Comparison to last month with trend arrow (up = more waste red, down = less waste green). Simple and clear, no chart needed.

subtasks.title: Build Most Purchased Items list
subtasks.description: Ranked list of top 5-10 most purchased items (by transaction count). Each row: rank number, item name, purchase count. Optional: horizontal bar chart using BarMark.

subtasks.title: Build Category Spending Breakdown chart
subtasks.description: Bar chart grouped by category. Each bar = total spend in that category for the month. Flat color bars (different colors per category, no gradients). Chart padding 16pt. Handle empty state with 'No data yet' message.

tasks.title: Profile Screen
tasks.description: Build the Profile screen with user info, family members list with roles, notification settings toggles, and data settings (export data, delete account).
tasks.details:
1. User Info section.
2. Family Members section.
3. Notification Settings toggles.
4. Data Settings (export, delete).
5. Edit profile.
6. Persist notification preferences.
tasks.testStrategy: Test sections render. Test toggles persist. Test export output. Test delete account flow. Test add member navigation.

subtasks.title: Create ProfileViewModel
subtasks.description: Create ViewModels/ProfileViewModel.swift. Properties: currentUser (User), householdName, members ([User]), notificationPreferences (expiry toggle, lowStock toggle). Methods: updateName(), signOut(), exportData(), deleteAccount().

subtasks.title: Build ProfileView with sectioned Form/List
subtasks.description: Create Views/Profile/ProfileView.swift. Form with sections: User Info, Family Members, Notifications, Data Settings. Clean list styling with DesignSystem spacing and typography.

subtasks.title: Build User Info section
subtasks.description: Section showing: name (editable via tap to edit sheet), email (read-only), household name. Profile avatar with initials at top.

subtasks.title: Build Notification Settings section
subtasks.description: Toggles: 'Expiry Reminders' and 'Low Stock Reminders'. Persist to Supabase user profile or UserDefaults. On toggle change, update notification scheduling.

subtasks.title: Build Data Settings section
subtasks.description: 'Export Data' button: generates JSON/CSV of user's pantry and transaction data. Share sheet for export. 'Delete Account' button: red destructive style, confirmation alert ('This cannot be undone'), calls Supabase to delete user data and sign out.

tasks.title: Local Notifications System
tasks.description: Implement local notifications for expiry alerts (3 days before) and low stock threshold triggers. Default delivery time 9am local.
tasks.details:
1. Request notification permissions.
2. Daily 9am check for expiring items.
3. Schedule notifications.
4. Low stock triggers.
5. Tap opens filtered Pantry.
6. Respect user preferences.
7. Batch to avoid fatigue.
tasks.testStrategy: Test scheduling with mock dates. Test tap opens filtered view. Test toggles disable notifications. Test batching. Test permission denial.

subtasks.title: Create NotificationService
subtasks.description: Create Services/NotificationService.swift. Methods: requestPermission(), scheduleExpiryAlerts(items:), scheduleLowStockAlerts(items:), cancelAll(), updateSchedule(). Uses UNUserNotificationCenter.

subtasks.title: Implement notification permission request
subtasks.description: Request .alert, .badge, .sound permissions during onboarding. Handle denied state gracefully (show settings prompt if denied). Store permission state.

subtasks.title: Implement expiry alert scheduling
subtasks.description: For each pantry item with expiryDate within 3 days: schedule a UNTimeIntervalNotification for 9am local on the day that is 3 days before expiry. Content: 'item.name expires in X days'. Batch multiple items into one notification if >3 items expiring same day.

subtasks.title: Implement low stock notification
subtasks.description: When a pantry item's quantity drops to or below lowStockThreshold, schedule a notification. Content: 'item.name is running low'. Deliver at 9am next day. Avoid re-notifying for same item within 7 days.

subtasks.title: Handle notification tap navigation
subtasks.description: Set UNNotificationCategory and actionIdentifier. On tap: open app → navigate to Pantry tab with 'Expiring' segment selected (for expiry alerts) or 'Low Stock' segment (for low stock alerts). Use NotificationCenter or deep link handling.

subtasks.title: Respect user notification preferences
subtasks.description: Check Profile notification toggles before scheduling. If expiryReminders == false, skip expiry notifications. If lowStockReminders == false, skip low stock notifications. Re-evaluate when toggles change.

tasks.title: Offline Support and Sync Queue
tasks.description: Implement offline-first architecture with SwiftData local cache, sync queue, and conflict resolution (last write wins with timestamp).
tasks.details:
1. SwiftData models mirroring Supabase schema.
2. Local CRUD operations.
3. Sync queue with pending operations.
4. Retry every 30s up to 5 attempts.
5. Persistent failure banner.
6. Sync pending badge.
7. Last write wins via updatedAt.
8. Process queue on reconnect.
tasks.testStrategy: Test offline CRUD. Test sync queue on reconnect. Test conflict resolution. Test retry logic and banner. Test sync badge.

subtasks.title: Create SwiftData models
subtasks.description: Create SwiftData @Model classes mirroring Supabase schema: SDPantryItem, SDShoppingItem, SDTransaction, SDUser, SDHousehold. Include a syncStatus field (enum: synced, pending, failed). Configure ModelContainer in App entry point.

subtasks.title: Implement local CRUD via SwiftData
subtasks.description: Create LocalRepository implementations that read/write from SwiftData. All user-facing operations go through local first. PantryRepository, ShoppingRepository, TransactionRepository all write locally before syncing.

subtasks.title: Create SyncQueue service
subtasks.description: Create Services/SyncQueueService.swift. Maintains a queue of pending operations (insert/update/delete + entity type + data). On network available: process queue in FIFO order. Each operation calls the corresponding Supabase repository method.

subtasks.title: Implement retry logic and failure banner
subtasks.description: SyncQueue retries failed operations every 30 seconds, max 5 attempts. After 5 failures: mark operation as failed, show a persistent banner at top of screen ('Some changes haven't synced. Check your connection.'). Use NWPathMonitor to detect connectivity changes.

subtasks.title: Implement conflict resolution (last write wins)
subtasks.description: On sync: compare local updatedAt with remote updatedAt. If remote is newer, overwrite local. If local is newer, push to remote. Ties: remote wins. Log conflicts for debugging. Update local SwiftData record with resolved data.

subtasks.title: Add sync status badge to UI
subtasks.description: Show a subtle badge/icon on items where syncStatus == .pending. Small cloud icon with exclamation mark or similar. Visible in PantryItemRow and ShoppingItemRow. Disappears once synced.

tasks.title: Error Handling System
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling: network failure, permission denied modal, validation errors (inline), and conflict resolution.
tasks.details:
1. Network failure → save locally + retry.
2. Permission denied → 403 modal.
3. Validation → inline errors.
4. Conflict resolution → last write wins.
5. ErrorHandler service.
6. Haptic on validation errors.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each error type UI response. Test retry. Test permission modal. Test inline validation.

subtasks.title: Create AppError enum
subtasks.description: Create Models/AppError.swift enum: networkFailure(Error), permissionDenied, validationError([String]), conflict, serverError(Int, String), unknown(Error). Conform to LocalizedError with user-friendly errorDescription for each case.

subtasks.title: Create ErrorHandler service
subtasks.description: Create Services/ErrorHandler.swift. Method: handle(error:) that classifies raw errors into AppError cases. Maps Supabase/URLSession errors to user-friendly messages. Triggers appropriate UI response (modal, banner, inline error).

subtasks.title: Implement permission denied modal
subtasks.description: Create a reusable PermissionDeniedView as an alert/sheet. Title: 'Permission Denied'. Message: 'You do not have permission to perform this action.' Dismiss button. Triggered when RLS returns 403 or PermissionService denies action.

subtasks.title: Implement network failure banner
subtasks.description: Create Views/Components/SyncBanner.swift. Persistent banner at top of screen when offline or sync failing. Text: 'No internet connection' or 'Sync failed. Retrying...'. Auto-dismiss when reconnected and synced. Animate in/out.

subtasks.title: Create reusable inline validation error component
subtasks.description: Create Views/Components/ValidationErrorText.swift. Small red text (caption size, Error Red color) displayed below form fields. Takes an optional error string. Shows/hides with animation. Used throughout all forms in the app.

tasks.title: Analytics Event Tracking
tasks.description: Implement analytics tracking for key events: item_added, item_deleted, shopping_transferred, expiry_notification_opened, duplicate_prevented, cost_entered.
tasks.details:

2. Event enum.
3. Payload: userId, householdId, timestamp, featureName.
4. Pluggable backend.
5. Integrate at trigger points.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify events fire at correct triggers. Test payload fields. Test error handling.

subtasks.title: Create AnalyticsEvent enum and TrackingPayload
subtasks.description: Create Services/Analytics/AnalyticsEvent.swift enum: itemAdded, itemDeleted, shoppingTransferred, expiryNotificationOpened, duplicatePrevented, costEntered. Create TrackingPayload struct: userId (String), householdId (String), timestamp (Date), featureName (String), metadata (optional [String: Any]).

subtasks.title: Create TrackingService protocol and implementation
subtasks.description: Create Services/Analytics/TrackingService.swift protocol with track(event:payload:). Create a concrete implementation (e.g., ConsoleTrackingService for development that prints events). Design for pluggable backends (Firebase Analytics, Mixpanel, etc.).

subtasks.title: Integrate tracking at all trigger points
subtasks.description: Add tracking calls: itemAdded in PantryRepository.add() and ShoppingRepository.add(). itemDeleted in delete methods. shoppingTransferred in TransferViewModel.executeTransfer(). expiryNotificationOpened in notification tap handler. duplicatePrevented in duplicate detection logic. costEntered when cost field is filled during transfer.

tasks.title: Accessibility Compliance
tasks.description: Ensure full accessibility: Dynamic Type support, VoiceOver compatibility, minimum 44pt touch targets, and color-independent status indicators across all screens.
tasks.details:
1. Dynamic Type with @ScaledMetric.
2. VoiceOver labels and hints.
3. 44pt touch targets.
4. Color-independent indicators.
5. WCAG AA contrast.
6. Correct reading order.
tasks.testStrategy: Audit with Accessibility Inspector. Test VoiceOver flow. Verify Dynamic Type sizes. Check contrast ratios.

subtasks.title: Add Dynamic Type support across all views
subtasks.description: Replace all fixed font sizes with @ScaledMetric or .font(.system(size:)) that responds to Dynamic Type. Test at accessibility large sizes. Ensure layouts don't break at maximum sizes — use ScrollView where needed.

subtasks.title: Add VoiceOver labels and hints to interactive elements
subtasks.description: Add .accessibilityLabel() to all buttons, icons, and non-text elements. Add .accessibilityHint() for actions (e.g., 'Double tap to add item'). Add .accessibilityValue() for dynamic content (e.g., progress bars, toggle states). Group related elements with .accessibilityElement(children: .combine).

subtasks.title: Verify and fix 44pt minimum touch targets
subtasks.description: Audit all buttons, checkboxes, toggle areas, and swipe action triggers. Ensure frame is at least 44pt in height and width. Use .contentShape(Rectangle()) to expand tap areas where needed. Fix any undersized targets.

subtasks.title: Add color-independent status indicators
subtasks.description: For expiring items: add clock icon in addition to red color. For low stock: add arrow.down icon. For expired: add exclamationmark.triangle icon. For syncing: add cloud icon. Ensure status is communicated even without color perception.

subtasks.title: Audit contrast ratios for both themes
subtasks.description: Verify all text/background combinations meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Check both light and dark mode. Use the Accessibility Inspector contrast checker. Fix any failing combinations.

tasks.title: Performance Optimization and App Store Preparation
tasks.description: Optimize app to meet performance ceilings (launch <2s, pantry load <1s, memory <150MB). Prepare for App Store submission.
tasks.details:
1. Profile launch time < 2s.
2. Pantry load < 1s.
3. Memory < 150MB.
4. Query time < 300ms.
5. Test with max data.
6. Lazy loading and pagination.
7. 80% test coverage.
8. App Store assets.
tasks.testStrategy: Instruments profiling. Benchmark with max data. No console warnings. Full test suite with coverage.

subtasks.title: Profile and optimize app launch time
subtasks.description: Use Instruments Time Profiler to measure cold launch time. Target: under 2 seconds on iPhone 13 baseline. Optimize: defer non-critical initialization, lazy load view models, minimize work in App init and onAppear of first screen.

subtasks.title: Profile and optimize Pantry screen load
subtasks.description: Measure pantry load time with 10,000 items. Target: under 1 second. Implement pagination (load 50-100 items at a time), LazyVStack instead of VStack, efficient filtering. Cache sorted/filtered results.

subtasks.title: Optimize memory usage
subtasks.description: Use Instruments Allocations to measure peak memory. Target: under 150MB. Optimize: release image caches, avoid retaining large collections in memory, use @Query with fetch limits in SwiftData.

subtasks.title: Achieve 80% unit test coverage
subtasks.description: Write unit tests for: all ViewModels, all Services, all Repository implementations, PantryItem state machine, financial calculations, bankers rounding, validation logic. Run coverage report and fill gaps to reach 80%+.

subtasks.title: Remove all console warnings
subtasks.description: Run the app in debug and scan console for warnings. Fix: layout constraint warnings, deprecation warnings, threading warnings (purple runtime issues). Ensure clean console in release build.

subtasks.title: Prepare App Store assets and metadata
subtasks.description: Create app icon (1024x1024) in all required sizes. Capture screenshots for iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone SE, iPad Pro. Write App Store description, keywords, and category. Configure privacy nutrition labels. Set up App Store Connect listing.
